_comment: Dismantly part types that eBay's category tree calls ENGINE parts but which do NOT depend on the engine. eBay's categories are coarser than these part types: category 33596 'ECUs & Computer Modules' holds Bluetooth, seat and body-control modules alongside the engine DME, so a category-derived Rule B restricted 511 of our listings to the donor's engine family when they fit the whole chassis. That UNDER-claims -- the listing shows fewer cars than it fits. Reviewed and approved by mendy 2026-08-28. He kept 'Engine Bracket Support Mount' as a genuine engine part (mounts differ between 4- and 6-cylinder) -- it is deliberately ABSENT from this list.
_effect: eBay category says B, this list says the part type is not engine-dependent -> use Rule A.
